source: Poly Haven (polyhaven.com), HDRI "Evening Road 01 (Pure Sky)" -- original by Sergej Majboroda, sky edit by Jarod Guest
license: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain) -- Poly Haven's site-wide asset license, no attribution required; credited here anyway as this project's own convention for any real external data (see data/military-circle-context-buildings.geojson's own _provenance).
resolution: 1k (2048x1024) -- the smallest Poly Haven offers, chosen deliberately: only used as real-time IBL lighting + a background skybox for a small procedural massing model, not a hero background image, so higher resolution would be wasted bytes.
purpose: Real low-sun, early-evening sky lighting (Poly Haven's own description: "evening sky with low golden sun, cool blue tones, scattered clouds and medium-contrast lighting") for the public/index.html and public/walk.html <model-viewer>/three.js scenes -- replaces kloofendal_43d_clear_puresky_1k.hdr (a high-contrast MIDDAY sky, per that file's own removed provenance) specifically for the longer, more raking shadows a low sun angle casts across real building massing, which reads as more real contrast on the model itself even though Poly Haven's own per-asset tag calls this HDRI's overall luminance range "medium contrast" (a property of the sky dome's own histogram, not of the shadows it casts on geometry sitting under it).
